title: Revisiting Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning from A Cross-Domain Perspective
authors_zh: Jorge (Zhoujun) Cheng, Shibo Hao, Tianyang Liu, Fan Zhou, Yutao Xie, Feng Yao, Yuexin Bian, Nilabjo Dey, Yonghao Zhuang, Yuheng Zha, Yi Gu, Kun Zhou, Yuqi Wang, Yuan Li, Richard Fan, Jianshu She, Chengqian Gao, Abulhair Saparov, Taylor W. Killian, Haonan Li, Mikhail Yurochkin, Eric P. Xing, Zhengzhong Liu, Zhiting Hu
paper_type_zh: 多领域 RLVR 数据发布与构建研究
best_for_zh: 适合构建、复现或审计跨领域强化学习推理数据与验证器契约的研究者。
one_line: GURU filters about 684.9K public and synthetic candidates into 91,909 training rows spanning mathematics, code, science, logic, simulation, and tables, with rule, execution, or model-based rewards.
GURU 将约 68.49 万条候选过滤为 91,909 条六领域 RLVR 训练记录，并为不同领域配置规则、执行或模型验证奖励。
why: It exposes a comparatively complete cross-domain RL data contract while leaving material uncertainty around semantic contamination, verifier error, mixed-license lineage, rejected candidates, and absent policy rollouts.
inclusion_reason: GURU is central to the open-release track because it joins a six-domain training mixture to explicit rule, execution, and model-verifier contracts, filtering thresholds, training code, checkpoints, and evaluation tooling.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open reinforcement-learning research for reasoning has centered on mathematics and code, where exact answers and unit tests make reward construction relatively straightforward. That concentration leaves two linked questions under-tested: whether gains learned in one reasoning domain transfer to others, and whether a single RL-trained model can improve broadly without sacrificing domains that require different output forms and checking procedures.

GURU frames the bottleneck as a data-and-feedback problem rather than only a model problem. A useful cross-domain corpus must join each prompt to a verifier that can score newly sampled policy responses. It must also control duplication, malformed examples, trivial questions, and rewards that are too weak to guide learning. A uniform question-answer file is insufficient because a symbolic answer, a program, an open-ended science explanation, a simulation output, and a table-derived answer demand different correctness contracts.

The paper therefore asks how to construct and test one RL-ready mixture spanning mathematics, code, science, logic, simulation, and tabular reasoning. The audit question is narrower than the reported benchmark ranking: what exactly is released, how each row was selected and checked, and which missing artifacts prevent replaying or challenging those decisions?

开放的推理强化学习研究长期集中在数学和代码领域，因为精确答案与单元测试较容易形成自动奖励。这种集中留下了两个彼此相关、但尚未充分检验的问题：在一个领域中通过强化学习获得的能力能否迁移到其他领域，以及单一模型能否在不牺牲异构任务能力的前提下实现整体提升。

GURU 把这一瓶颈界定为数据与反馈契约问题，而不只是模型问题。跨领域语料必须把每个提示与能够评价新采样策略回答的验证器连接起来，同时控制重复、格式错误、过于简单的样本和弱奖励。统一的问答文件并不足够，因为符号答案、程序、开放式科学解释、模拟输出和表格答案需要不同的正确性判定方式。

因此，论文研究如何构建并检验一个覆盖数学、代码、科学、逻辑、模拟和表格推理的可直接用于强化学习的数据混合。审计重点并非基准排名本身，而是实际发布了什么、每条记录如何被选择和检查，以及哪些缺失制品妨碍对这些决定的复现与质疑。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
GURU is a released six-domain RLVR corpus filtered from about 684.9K raw candidates. At the pinned Hugging Face revision, Dataset Viewer exposes one 91,909-row train split with 17 columns. The paper reports rounded final counts of 54.4K mathematics, 18.1K code, 3.6K science, 6.3K logic, 3.7K simulation, and 6.1K tabular examples.

Its organizing object is a prompt plus a routed binary feedback contract:

  • mathematics, logic, simulation, and tabular tasks use structured extraction followed by exact, normalized, or symbolic matching;
  • code tasks execute Python against retained tests and reward only an all-tests-pass outcome;
  • open-ended science tasks use the 1.5B TIGER-Lab/general-verifier model to judge whether a response entails the reference answer.

The Parquet schema includes prompts, references or upstream answers, task-specific tests or inputs, source and ability labels, reward payloads, uniqueness flags, and pass rates from both difficulty-screening models. completion and response fields do exist, but they are not an archive of the on-policy responses sampled during the reported GRPO training. Rejected candidates, failed verification traces, and rollout reward histories are also absent.

The broader release includes preprocessing and filtering paths, reward implementations, veRL-based GRPO infrastructure, an evaluation suite, GURU-7B and GURU-32B checkpoints, and linked training logs. This makes it a more inspectable construction package than a paper-only claim, while still leaving paper-run version identity and several audit ledgers unresolved.

GURU 是从约 68.49 万条原始候选中筛选得到的六领域 RLVR 语料。在固定的 Hugging Face 修订版上，Dataset Viewer 展示了一个包含 91,909 行、17 列的训练划分。论文给出的领域规模为近似值：数学 54.4K、代码 18.1K、科学 3.6K、逻辑 6.3K、模拟 3.7K、表格 6.1K。

其核心组织方式是“提示加二元反馈契约”，并按领域路由：

  • 数学、逻辑、模拟与表格任务先抽取结构化答案，再进行精确、规范化或符号匹配；
  • 代码任务在保留的测试上执行 Python，只有全部测试通过才获得奖励；
  • 开放式科学任务使用 1.5B 的 TIGER-Lab/general-verifier 判断回答是否蕴含参考答案。

Parquet 模式包含提示、参考答案或上游回答、任务特定测试或输入、来源与能力标签、奖励载荷、唯一性标记，以及两个难度筛选模型的通过率。数据中确有 completion 和 response 字段，但它们不是论文所述 GRPO 训练期间采样的在线策略回答档案。被拒绝候选、失败验证轨迹和 rollout 奖励历史同样没有发布。

完整发布还包括预处理与筛选路径、奖励实现、基于 veRL 的 GRPO 基础设施、评测套件、GURU-7B 与 GURU-32B 检查点，以及训练日志链接。因此，它比只有论文结论的发布更可检查，但论文实验对应的精确代码版本和若干审计台账仍未确定。

title: Method
方法
html:
### Source assembly

Mathematics draws from OR1, DAPO, and DeepScaler. Code uses LeetCode, TACO-Verified, PrimeIntellect, and historical LiveCodeBench subsets. Science comes from WebInstruct-Verified. Logic combines ARC-AGI, ARC-AGI-2, BARC, and synthesized Zebra, ordering, and graph-search tasks. Simulation uses Code I/O/PyEdu, and tabular reasoning uses HiTab and MultiHierTT after table linearization. The pipeline reduces roughly 684.9K raw candidates to 209.6K after deduplication and domain filters, then to 91.9K after difficulty filtering.

### Deduplication and domain filters

Rather than relying on broad similarity thresholds that produced false positives in pilot work, the pipeline removes the shorter question when it is a strict substring of another. The paper reports that this removed 27.2% of mathematics and 7.5% of code candidates. Domain rules then remove overlong prompts and weakly specified or trivial cases. Code reference solutions must pass their tests; standard input is capped at 1 MB; at most eight tests are randomly retained per example. Simulation retains one input-output pair per program. Science is restricted to university- or PhD-level physics, chemistry, and biology and excludes boolean, multiple-choice, and high-precision numerical questions. Logic families use size or look-ahead thresholds.

### Difficulty filtering

Each remaining candidate is sampled 16 times by Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and 16 times by Qwen3-30B-A8B. The pipeline removes tasks that the weak model solves at least 15 times, that the strong model never solves, or for which the weak pass rate exceeds the strong pass rate. Mathematics also removes examples with a strong-model pass rate of at least 0.75 but a weak-strong gap of at most 6/16. Science requires a gap of at least 0.5. The retained pass rates are published as row fields, but candidate-level rejection records and random seeds are not.

### Reward and optimization contract

Rewards are binary and routed by data_source. Structured domains extract boxed answers, special tags, or JSON and normalize before matching; mathematics adds symbolic equivalence handling. Python code is run with a 30-second timeout and all selected tests must pass, with fuzzy comparison for standard input/output tasks. The science model verifier judges entailment against a reference answer.

The reported GURU-7B and GURU-32B runs start directly from Qwen2.5 base models, without SFT, and train for two epochs using GRPO in veRL. One RL step contains 512 prompts and 16 responses per prompt at temperature 1.0; mini-batches of 64 yield eight gradient updates. Limits are 4K prompt tokens and 8K generated tokens. The 7B run uses four nodes and the 32B run sixteen nodes, each with eight Hopper GPUs; each run takes about 2.5 days.

### 来源组装

数学数据来自 OR1、DAPO 和 DeepScaler；代码数据来自 LeetCode、TACO-Verified、PrimeIntellect 与历史 LiveCodeBench 子集；科学数据来自 WebInstruct-Verified。逻辑数据包括 ARC-AGI、ARC-AGI-2、BARC，以及合成的 Zebra、排序和图搜索任务。模拟采用 Code I/O/PyEdu，表格推理采用经过线性化的 HiTab 与 MultiHierTT。流水线把约 68.49 万条原始候选缩减为去重和领域过滤后的 20.96 万条，再经难度筛选得到约 9.19 万条。

### 去重与领域过滤

广义相似度阈值在先导实验中产生较多误报，因此流水线采用更保守的规则：若一个问题是另一个问题的严格子串，就删除较短者。论文报告该步骤移除了 27.2% 的数学候选和 7.5% 的代码候选。随后，各领域规则删除过长提示、定义薄弱或过于简单的样本。代码参考解必须通过测试，标准输入不超过 1 MB，每题随机保留至多八个测试；模拟任务每个程序只保留一个输入输出对；科学任务限于大学或博士水平的物理、化学和生物学，并排除布尔题、选择题和高精度数值题；逻辑任务则使用规模或前瞻深度阈值。

### 难度筛选

每个候选分别由 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-30B-A8B 采样 16 次。若弱模型至少答对 15 次、强模型一次也未答对，或弱模型通过率高于强模型，该任务会被移除。数学任务还会删除强模型通过率至少为 0.75、但强弱差距不超过 6/16 的样本；科学任务要求差距至少为 0.5。最终通过率作为行字段发布，但候选级拒绝记录与随机种子没有公开。

### 奖励与优化契约

奖励为二元值，并依据 data_source 路由。结构化领域从 boxed answer、特定标签或 JSON 中抽取答案并规范化匹配，数学还处理符号等价；Python 代码在 30 秒超时的沙箱中执行，所有选中测试都必须通过，标准输入输出任务允许模糊比较；科学模型验证器根据参考答案判断语义蕴含。

论文中的 GURU-7B 与 GURU-32B 直接从 Qwen2.5 base model 开始，不经过 SFT，在 veRL 中使用 GRPO 训练两个 epoch。每个 RL step 包含 512 个提示，每个提示以 temperature 1.0 采样 16 个回答；mini-batch 为 64，因此每步有八次梯度更新。提示上限为 4K token，生成上限为 8K token。7B 运行使用四个节点，32B 使用十六个节点，每个节点有八张 Hopper GPU；两次训练各约耗时 2.5 天。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper separates a controlled transfer study from full-mixture training. For the transfer study, GURU-18K samples 3K examples from each of the six domains and compares single-domain RL with uniform mixed-domain RL on Qwen2.5-7B-Base. Mathematics, code, and science transfer more readily across domains, whereas logic, simulation, and tables benefit more from in-domain data. Uniform mixed training often matches or exceeds single-domain training, but the authors' explanation that pretraining exposure drives these differences is an interpretation, not a measured property of the corpus.

A difficulty ablation compares raw and filtered mathematics. Filtering raises reported scores by 2.8 points on MATH500, 6.3 on AMC, and 5.9 on AIME24, while cross-domain effects are mixed: HumanEval falls 9.2 points, LiveCodeBench 0.4, and HiTab 3.0, whereas MultiHierTT rises 3.5. Response length also does not increase uniformly: the paper reports growth mainly for mathematics and science in the mixed setting, with domain-specific dynamics elsewhere. These results support the claim that selection and mixture choices alter training behavior; they do not establish that every retained row or verifier decision is correct.

For full training, the paper evaluates GURU-7B and GURU-32B on 17 benchmarks spanning the six domains plus IFEval and LiveBench. It reports aggregate averages of 41.17 and 52.68 and improvements over selected open RL baselines. Evaluation uses temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.95, with pass-at-k or average-at-k variants depending on the benchmark. These scores show that the released recipe can produce useful checkpoints, but benchmark performance is not a direct data-quality audit.

Artifact evidence is comparatively strong. The pinned dataset revision is public and inspectable; the current code tree contains preprocessing, model filtering, reward routing, training, and evaluation components; two public model repositories expose immutable revisions; and the repository links public training logs. However, the current code main revision postdates the paper and has no paper-era release tag, so exact run replay remains uncertain.

论文把受控迁移研究与完整混合训练分开。迁移研究构建 GURU-18K，从六个领域各随机抽取 3K 条样本，在 Qwen2.5-7B-Base 上比较单领域 RL 与均匀混合领域 RL。数学、代码和科学较容易向其他领域迁移，而逻辑、模拟和表格更依赖领域内数据。均匀混合训练经常达到或超过单领域训练，但作者用预训练暴露程度解释这些差异，这是一种推断，并非对语料属性的直接测量。

难度消融比较原始数学数据与筛选后数据。筛选使 MATH500、AMC 和 AIME24 的报告分数分别提高 2.8、6.3 和 5.9 分，但跨领域影响并不一致：HumanEval 下降 9.2 分，LiveCodeBench 下降 0.4 分，HiTab 下降 3.0 分，而 MultiHierTT 上升 3.5 分。回答长度也没有普遍增长：混合设置下主要是数学和科学变长，其他领域呈现不同动态。这些结果支持“选择与混合方式会改变训练行为”，但不能证明每条保留记录或每次验证器判定都正确。

完整训练部分在覆盖六领域的 17 个基准以及 IFEval、LiveBench 上评估 GURU-7B 与 GURU-32B，报告的聚合均值分别为 41.17 和 52.68，并优于所选开放 RL 基线。评测使用 temperature 0.6、top-p 0.95，并依任务采用 pass-at-k 或 average-at-k 口径。这些分数说明该发布配方能够产生有用的检查点，但基准表现不是数据质量的直接审计。

制品证据相对充分：固定修订版数据公开且可检查；当前代码树包含预处理、模型筛选、奖励路由、训练与评测组件；两个公开模型仓库都有不可变修订；仓库还链接了公开训练日志。不过，当前代码主分支晚于论文且没有论文时期的 release tag，因此精确复现实验运行仍有不确定性。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
GURU's main contribution is not a new response format. It packages heterogeneous reasoning tasks as one trainable relation between prompts and executable feedback contracts. Rule matching, symbolic normalization, code execution, and model-based science judgment are routed within a shared schema and optimization pipeline rather than flattened into a single answer-comparison rule.

The construction recipe also applies one empirical difficulty language across domains: 16 response trials from a weaker model and 16 from a stronger model. Pass-rate thresholds jointly target triviality, impossible or malformed questions, and anomalous weak-greater-than-strong behavior. Domain-specific gap thresholds preserve some local adaptation instead of pretending all reward channels have identical calibration.

Relative to mathematics- or code-only RLVR releases, GURU adds open-ended science, synthetic symbolic logic, code-input/output simulation, and hierarchical table reasoning. Relative to a model report, it releases the training mixture, row-level pass-rate fields, verifier inputs, preprocessing and reward code, checkpoints, evaluation tooling, and logs. The novelty is therefore an inspectable cross-domain construction-and-feedback package, not proof that mixing always transfers positively or that the final corpus is contamination-free.

GURU 的主要贡献不是新的回答格式，而是把异构推理任务统一组织为“提示与可执行反馈契约”的可训练关系。规则匹配、符号规范化、代码执行和基于模型的科学答案判断在同一模式与优化流水线中按领域路由，而不是被压平成单一的答案比较规则。

构建配方还在各领域之间采用统一的经验难度度量：弱模型与强模型各进行 16 次回答试验。通过率阈值共同用于排除过于简单、疑似无法求解或格式错误，以及弱模型反而优于强模型的异常任务；数学与科学的额外差距阈值则保留了领域适配，而没有假定所有奖励通道具有相同校准程度。

相较于仅含数学或代码的 RLVR 发布，GURU 加入开放式科学、合成符号逻辑、代码输入输出模拟和层次表格推理。相较于单纯的模型报告，它公开训练混合、行级通过率字段、验证器输入、预处理与奖励代码、检查点、评测工具和日志。因此，创新点是一个可检查的跨领域构建与反馈包，而不是“混合训练必然正迁移”或“最终语料没有污染”的证明。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Strict-substring deduplication is transparent but deliberately narrow. It cannot remove paraphrases, translations, templated variants, or semantically equivalent tasks. The paper does not provide a systematic overlap report against all 17 evaluation benchmarks, even though some source mixtures include competition and historical benchmark material.

The three reward families have different failure surfaces. Exact extraction can reject equivalent expressions or reward a correct final token without valid reasoning. Code checking retains at most eight randomly selected tests per item, so under-specified tests can admit incorrect programs. The 1.5B science verifier can make false-positive and false-negative entailment judgments, but the release does not publish calibration measurements or adjudicated error samples. Binary rewards reveal no partial-credit or reasoning-process validity.

Difficulty filtering inherits model and verifier biases. Removing every task missed by Qwen3-30B-A8B can discard genuinely hard or novel questions, while pass-rate gaps can reflect memorization, decoding variance, or reward bugs rather than learnable difficulty. The published row-level pass rates help analysis, but rejected candidates, stage-level counts by source, seeds, and decision reasons are missing.

License lineage needs record-level review. The dataset repository carries an MIT label and the code is Apache-2.0, while the paper names upstream material under MIT, Apache-2.0, CC BY 4.0, and CC BY-SA. The aggregate label does not demonstrate that attribution, share-alike, platform, and model-output obligations are satisfied for every row. The two released model repositories are separately labeled CC-BY-NC-4.0.

Release-state ambiguity also matters. Dataset revision 2e2790a962a3c099bfb5ea61389cbf98a5ea439b is pinnable, but the live Reasoning360 main branch has evolved beyond the paper and has no release tag. Dataset Viewer exposes one train split, although online and offline evaluation Parquets coexist in the repository. A spot-check also surfaced mojibake in a LeetCode row; its prevalence is unknown.

Finally, the reported two-epoch direct-RL runs do not test an SFT-then-RL alternative, longer training, or fine-grained scaling and online mixture policies. On-policy responses, rejected rollouts, reward distributions, and failed verifier traces are not released, limiting audits of reward hacking and training dynamics. Coverage is English-centric and STEM-heavy despite the six-domain framing.

严格子串去重透明但范围刻意较窄，无法删除释义、翻译、模板变体或语义等价任务。论文没有提供针对全部 17 个评测基准的系统重叠报告，而部分来源混合本身包含竞赛题和历史基准材料。

三类奖励具有不同的失效面。精确抽取可能拒绝等价表达，也可能只因最终答案符号正确而奖励无效推理。代码检查每题至多随机保留八个测试，因此覆盖不足的测试可能放过错误程序。1.5B 科学验证器可能产生假阳性或假阴性的蕴含判断，但发布没有给出校准测量或人工裁决的错误样本。二元奖励也不反映部分正确程度或中间推理的有效性。

难度筛选继承模型与验证器偏差。删除 Qwen3-30B-A8B 全部失败的任务，可能舍弃真正困难或新颖的问题；通过率差距也可能反映记忆、解码方差或奖励实现错误，而非可学习难度。公开的行级通过率有助于分析，但被拒绝候选、按来源统计的阶段数量、随机种子和决策原因均未发布。

许可谱系需要逐记录审查。数据仓库标注 MIT，代码仓库为 Apache-2.0，而论文列出的上游材料还包括 CC BY 4.0 与 CC BY-SA。聚合标签不能证明每条记录都满足署名、相同方式共享、平台条款与模型输出义务。两个模型仓库另行标注为 CC-BY-NC-4.0。

发布状态也存在歧义。数据修订 2e2790a962a3c099bfb5ea61389cbf98a5ea439b 可以固定，但 Reasoning360 当前主分支已在论文之后继续演进，且没有 release tag。Dataset Viewer 只展示一个训练划分，而仓库中同时存有 online 与 offline evaluation Parquet。抽查还在一条 LeetCode 记录中发现乱码，但其普遍程度未知。

最后，论文报告的两轮直接 RL 没有检验先 SFT 后 RL、更长训练、细粒度缩放或在线混合策略。在线策略回答、被拒绝 rollout、奖励分布和验证失败轨迹没有发布，限制了对 reward hacking 与训练动态的审计。虽然覆盖六个领域，内容仍以英语和 STEM 为主。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For direct experimentation, GURU is a ready-to-load six-domain GRPO mixture with the references and reward payloads needed by its domain router. The published weak- and strong-model pass rates support curriculum construction, difficulty reweighting, disagreement analysis, and controlled resampling without first recomputing 32 screening responses per candidate. The repository's reward modules can also serve as concrete starting points for rule, execution, and model-judge infrastructure.

For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, the card is most useful as an end-to-end case study: upstream source selection leads to conservative deduplication, domain heuristics, empirical difficulty screening, verifier routing, and downstream training. The release makes those layers visible enough to compare alternative semantic deduplication, verifier calibration, test generation, and mixture policies. The controlled GURU-18K setup provides a natural baseline for studying positive and negative cross-domain transfer.

For auditing, the release is equally useful as a boundary case. It shows how apparently rich openness—data, code, models, and logs—can still omit the ledgers needed to explain why an individual candidate was rejected, which source license governs a row, or what rewards a policy actually received. A careful reuse should pin dataset revision 2e2790a962a3c099bfb5ea61389cbf98a5ea439b, preserve data_source, extra_info, reward payloads, and both pass-rate fields, and independently audit evaluation overlap and upstream licenses.

The corpus should not be treated as a generic reasoning-trace dataset. It is best suited to answer-level RLVR and feedback-contract research; projects requiring archived policy trajectories, process supervision, preference pairs, calibrated scalar rewards, or multilingual coverage need additional data.

在直接实验中，GURU 是一个可加载的六领域 GRPO 混合，包含其领域路由器所需的参考信息与奖励载荷。公开的弱模型和强模型通过率支持课程构建、难度重加权、分歧分析与受控重采样，使用者无需先为每个候选重新计算 32 个筛选回答。仓库中的奖励模块也可作为规则验证、代码执行和模型裁判基础设施的具体起点。

对于“数据构建与开放发布配方”轨道，这张卡最适合作为端到端案例：上游来源选择依次连接到保守去重、领域启发式、经验难度筛选、验证器路由和下游训练。公开层次足以支持比较语义去重、验证器校准、测试生成和数据混合策略的替代方案。受控的 GURU-18K 设置还为研究跨领域正迁移与负迁移提供了自然基线。

从审计角度看，它也是一个有价值的边界案例。即使数据、代码、模型和日志均已公开，发布仍可能缺少解释单个候选为何被拒绝、某行受何种来源许可约束，或策略实际收到何种奖励的台账。严谨复用应固定数据修订 2e2790a962a3c099bfb5ea61389cbf98a5ea439b，保留 data_source、extra_info、奖励载荷和两个通过率字段，并独立检查评测重叠与上游许可。

这份语料不应被当作通用推理轨迹数据集。它最适合答案级 RLVR 和反馈契约研究；需要已归档策略轨迹、过程监督、偏好对、校准标量奖励或多语言覆盖的项目，还需要补充其他数据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Pin the data to revision 2e2790a962a3c099bfb5ea61389cbf98a5ea439b: it exposes exactly 91,909 training rows and 17 columns; the paper's six domain counts are rounded and should not be summed as exact counts.
  • Read GURU as prompts plus references and verifier payloads, not as 91,909 stored policy reasoning trajectories.
  • The five construction stages are sourcing, substring deduplication, reward design, domain-specific heuristics, and weak-versus-strong difficulty filtering.
  • Difficulty scores come from 16 trials each with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen3-30B-A8B; both pass rates remain in the released rows.
  • Verifier families are rule or symbolic match, all-tests-pass Python execution, and 1.5B model-based science entailment; performance gains do not prove every row, reward, or license decision valid.
  • Highest-priority missing evidence: evaluation-overlap ledgers, record-level source and license lineage, rejected candidates, verifier calibration, paper-era code tag, and on-policy rollout/reward traces.

• 数据应固定到修订 2e2790a962a3c099bfb5ea61389cbf98a5ea439b；该版本精确包含 91,909 条训练记录和 17 个字段，而论文中的领域数量是不能相加为精确总量的近似值。
  • 应把 GURU 理解为提示、参考信息与验证器载荷的组合，而不是 91,909 条已保存的策略推理轨迹。
  • 五个构建阶段是来源收集、子串去重、奖励设计、领域启发式过滤，以及基于强弱模型的难度筛选。
  • 难度分数来自 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 与 Qwen3-30B-A8B 各 16 次试验；两个通过率均保存在发布行中。
  • 三类验证器分别是规则或符号匹配、全部测试通过的 Python 执行，以及 1.5B 模型对科学答案的语义蕴含判断；基准提升不证明每条数据、奖励或许可决定均有效。
  • 最优先缺失的证据包括：评测重叠台账、行级来源与许可谱系、被拒绝候选、验证器校准、论文时期代码标签，以及在线 rollout 与奖励轨迹。

value.html: GURU combines OR1, DAPO, and DeepScaler mathematics prompts; LeetCode, TACO-Verified, PrimeIntellect, and historical LiveCodeBench code tasks; WebInstruct-Verified science questions; ARC-AGI, BARC, and three synthesized logic families; Code I/O/PyEdu simulation tasks; and HiTab and MultiHierTT table questions.

The pinned Parquet release stores message-list prompts plus task-specific references and verifier inputs. Expected outputs include boxed or tagged answers, JSON, executable Python, and open-ended science responses.

The release contains prompts, verifier payloads, and some upstream or reference completion/response fields. It is not an archive of the on-policy responses sampled during the reported GRPO runs; those policy rollouts are unknown.

Offline multi-domain RLVR in veRL. Code candidates are checked by Python execution in a sandbox; the current repository documents SandboxFusion integration, while rule matchers and a served model verifier handle the other domains.

Every training response receives a binary domain-routed reward. Mathematics, logic, simulation, and tables use extraction plus rule or symbolic matching; code requires all retained tests to pass; science uses a 1.5B general verifier to judge entailment of the reference answer.
A sampled answer succeeds when its routed checker returns correct through normalized answer match, successful test execution, or positive science-entailment judgment.
Qwen2.5-7B-Base and Qwen2.5-32B-Base for the reported GURU-7B and GURU-32B runs.

Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen3-30B-A8B estimate difficulty; TIGER-Lab/general-verifier, a 1.5B model, judges open-ended science responses. Generators inside all upstream datasets are not uniformly disclosed.

The Qwen2.5 base policies sample responses on-policy during GRPO. The released training corpus preserves prompts, references, and reward inputs but not those sampled policy responses or rejected rollouts.
Difficulty estimation uses 16 trials per candidate from each screening model. RL samples 16 responses per prompt. Seeds and the order of candidates through all filtering stages are unknown.

A shorter question is removed when it is a strict substring of another. Domain heuristics remove overlong, malformed, weakly verified, or trivial tasks. Difficulty filtering excludes weak-model pass rate at least 15/16, strong-model pass rate zero, and weak pass rate above strong pass rate, with additional mathematics and science gap thresholds.
Training permits up to 4K prompt tokens and 8K generated tokens. Each RL step uses 512 prompts and 16 responses per prompt, with mini-batches of 64. Evaluation uses temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.95.
veRL GRPO with AdamW, a 10-step linear warmup, and two epochs. GURU-7B uses four eight-GPU nodes; GURU-32B uses sixteen eight-GPU nodes; each reported run lasts about 2.5 days.

The pinned Hugging Face revision exposes 91,909 training rows. Paper-rounded domain counts are 54.4K mathematics, 18.1K code, 3.6K science, 6.3K logic, 3.7K simulation, and 6.1K tabular records, retained from about 684.9K raw candidates.

Dataset Viewer exposes one default train split with 91,909 rows and 17 columns. The Hub repository also stores online and offline evaluation Parquets, but the default builder does not expose them as additional splits.
Within-corpus strict-substring deduplication is reported; systematic semantic or exact overlap checks against all 17 paper evaluation tasks are unknown.

items: Strict-substring deduplication misses paraphrases, translations, templated variants, and semantic benchmark overlap.
Exact or symbolic matching can reject equivalent answers and does not verify intermediate reasoning.
Code checking uses at most eight selected tests per sample, so incorrect programs can receive reward.
The 1.5B science verifier can make false-positive or false-negative entailment judgments; calibration statistics are unknown.
Difficulty filtering can discard genuinely hard tasks when the strong model fails all trials and inherits both screening models' capability and memorization biases.
A Dataset Viewer spot-check showed mojibake in a LeetCode example; prevalence and effect across the corpus are unknown.
English-centric, STEM-heavy coverage limits language and discipline representativeness.
Mixed upstream licenses and absent row-level license fields make redistribution obligations difficult to audit.
Rejected candidates, stage-specific rejection reasons, on-policy rollouts, failed verifier traces, and reward distributions are not released.

value.html: The dataset repository is labeled MIT and the code repository is Apache-2.0. The paper names upstream MIT, Apache-2.0, CC BY 4.0, and CC BY-SA assets. Record-level compatibility of the aggregate label is not established.

Public or synthesized tasks are normalized into domain prompts and reward inputs, substring-deduplicated, filtered with domain rules, scored in 16 trials by weak and strong models, and difficulty-filtered. Rows retain data_source and extra_info metadata, but a complete row-level source URL, license, and transformation manifest is unknown.

The code main branch postdates the paper and has no release tag, so exact paper-run code identity remains unknown.
